authority_boundary: This artifact supports provisional Library understanding and routing. It is not current-event verification, canonical identity, operator belief, public publication, or authority to act.
coverage_constraints: The admitted Latin body carries edition uncertainty and unknown body-level coverage.
Civilization Memory's Germania framing is an interpretation, not neutral scholarly consensus.
negative_route_rules: Never return Mare Liberum as neutral authority without disclosing the Dutch/VOC setting.
Do not infer contemporary international-law validity from this historical packet.

route_units.actor_or_character_configuration: A Dutch legal advocate in a VOC-linked contest with Portuguese exclusion joins Dutch access interest to a common right of navigation and trade.
route_units.analogy_affordance: An interested claimant presents its access claim as a rule available to humanity.
route_units.analytic_function: Test whether a universal rule remains analytically distinct from the claimant's positional advantage.
route_units.anti_analogy: Do not infer that interest disproves the principle, that universality proves neutrality, or that the tract decides current legal validity.
contraindications: Dismissing the principle merely because it served Dutch interest.
Treating universal language as proof of disinterestedness.
Equating open navigation with freedom from coercion.

counterweight_refs.role: The universal commercial right culminates in a claim to armed enforcement when adjudication is unavailable.
Dutch commercial freedom coexisted with VOC quasi-sovereignty, monopoly, and extraction.

enabling_conditions: The comparison contains an incumbent exclusion rule and a claimant seeking wider access.
The question concerns the portability or neutrality of the claimant's rule, not current legal validity.
route_units.expected_outcome: A narrowed or complicated model, not factual verification.
route_units.lineage_assessment: Primary passages establish the common-use argument and the conjunction of Dutch and human utility; contextual interpretation identifies the sponsor setting and is not independent corroboration.
route_units.mechanism: Claimant interest translated into portable legal grammar by aligning Dutch utility with common use.
route_units.proposition_or_pattern: An interested claimant can express its own access interest as a universal rule against incumbent exclusion.
route_units.rejection_condition: Reject when the candidate case lacks both an exclusionary incumbent rule and claimant-side universalization, or when the analogy is being used to decide current legal validity.
route_units.retrieval_problem: A universal rule also advantages the actor articulating it.

route_units.actor_or_character_configuration: A Dutch legal advocate in a VOC-linked contest with Portuguese exclusion joins a common-access claim to a claimed right of armed enforcement.
route_units.analogy_affordance: An actor couples a common-access claim to a claimed right of armed enforcement when adjudication is unavailable.
route_units.analytic_function: Test whether an access-opening principle also carries an enforcement claim without inferring later institutional outcomes.
route_units.anti_analogy: Do not claim equivalence across oceans, digital networks, or modern law, or infer a successor monopoly or realized commercial outcome without independent evidence.
contraindications: Dismissing the principle merely because it served Dutch interest.
Treating universal language as proof of disinterestedness.
Equating open navigation with freedom from coercion.
Inferring realized VOC outcomes from Grotius's legal argument alone.

counterweight_refs.role: The text itself joins open commerce to coercive enforcement through just war.
The Dutch Republic packet supplies dependent sponsor context; it is not independent evidence of a realized successor coercive order.

enabling_conditions: The comparison contains both an access-opening principle and a claimant-side enforcement claim or capacity.
The question concerns the coupling of access and enforcement, not proof of the subsequent political or commercial order.
route_units.expected_outcome: A narrowed or complicated model, not factual verification.
route_units.lineage_assessment: Primary passages establish the common commercial right and its claimed armed enforcement; contextual interpretation adds sponsor setting but is not independent evidence of realized coercive outcomes.
route_units.mechanism: Universal access claim coupled to coercive enforcement capacity.
route_units.proposition_or_pattern: A claim of common commercial access can be paired with a claim to armed enforcement when adjudication is unavailable.
route_units.rejection_condition: Reject when the candidate comparison contains only access liberalization or only coercion, or when a realized successor order is being inferred from the tract alone.
route_units.retrieval_problem: Open access is presented as common freedom while coercive enforcement is also authorized.
